Name: Green's Horses Continued
Author: Doragoun
Description:
I was sad that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245]Green's Redesigned Horse[/url] hadn't gotten an update for 1.6's yet, so I decided to take matters into my own hands which got slightly out of control. Officially okayed by the original author!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCrfQoK.png[/img]
Here's a list of what awaits you:
[list]
[*]Very pretty horse sprites made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/GreenJellyblob?gameId=1303]GreenJellyblob[/url]﻿
[*]A new eating animation for 1.6 spoiler items (aka the reason I made this in the first place)
[*]Nine different cota colors to choose from: the original six – vanilla, brown, blonde, white, gray and black (renamed to dark gray) – and three new ones made by yours truly – chestnut, dark brown and black
[*]Build your own horse: Seeing the original mod's lack of a proper config, I thought were was quite a bit to improve. You can now mix and match the nine coat colors mentioned in the paragraph above with six different mane and tail colors as well as nine different saddles. If anyone's got an idea just how many combinations there are, please let me know! All I can say is... there's a lot of possibilities!
[/list]
Sadly, hats you put on your horse will look weird and kind of clip through its neck. That's a known issue and nothing I can fix by myself using CP at the moment. I'd need a C# component, I have no experience in C# and, to quote people who actually know what they are talking about: "The horse's hat draw code [...] is significantly more cursed than expected anyways".

If you enjoy this mod, please consider endorsing it – it's easy, free, makes me happy and helps boost its visibility. Additionally, I'd be happy if you did the same for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245]Green's Redesigned Horse[/url]. Without it, this one wouldn't exist!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sgtIh0y.png[/img]﻿
Do you know how to download things and click buttons? Yes? Great! You'll have no trouble installing this.

[list=1]
[*]If you haven't already, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and, optionally, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Unzip it into your mod folder.
[*]Build your horse – or in other words, configure it however you like. I strongly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ for this!
[*]Open the game and lovingly stare at your new fancy horse.
[/list]If you want to uninstall the mod again, simply delete it from your mod folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z0XVWJf.png[/img]
Credit where credit's due:
[list]
[*]Huge thanks to GreenJellyblob themself for not only making these amazing sprites but also having very open permissions, being very easy to talk to and even allowing me to turn DP on!
[*]Airyn scopecreeped me into adding the mix-and-match style config, so you've got him to thank for configurability. However, he [i]also[/i] helped out with mane/tail and saddle overlays in turn and I'm very thankful for those, so... special mention it is!
[*]All the other friends I've made on the SDV server. You're all amazing.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Green's Horses Continued
Manifest.Description: Replaces the default horse with a new, reworked version, now with three new colors and an extensive config.
